priority: User literal requirements outrank any assistant interpretation; do not confuse this retriever with a completed self-discovered language world
exactly_preserved: Existing original V17/V22/V23 source code and old checkpoints unchanged; new worker uses separate runtime-v24-real

mechanism.witnessed: Observed human question -> assistant answer dialogue edge from actual Q/A rows
mechanism.inferred: New question similarity -> previously observed question is only HYPOTHESIS, visibly unverified
mechanism.method: Direct import and invocation of original V17 Discoverer.shape() over those state/action edges
mechanism.output: First-action entire path to a previously observed answer; no next-character prediction
mechanism.notProven: Novel unknown answer semantics and 4D/5D noise manifold discovery are NOT established

real_data_support: Existing V17 OpenThoughts3 Parquet reader without edits
Nested human/gpt conversations verified in CI
Safe dataset fingerprint-bound checkpoint and resume

runtime.graphics: new graph with actual nodes, edges, field, predicted path, sampled online metrics and heldout; old V17 UI embedded read-only by iframe if already running
runtime.persistence: atlas-v24.json atomic replacement; source fingerprint verified; resume restores trace, heldout and event history
runtime.backend: Node.js CPU for V24 text; no assertion of CUDA or user RTX 3050 Ti run

measured_CI.V23: 300/300 synthetic structured world routes; not natural Q/A
measured_CI.V24: native Linux source tests, real Parquet reader, generated nested OpenThoughts schema, Windows 5.1 launcher and live HTTP/checkpoint
measured_CI.stress: 12000 QA rows + 16 heldout, 8,743,482 input characters, 0.834 sec, 14,383.54 rows/s, 174.6 MB RSS on Linux CI; generated load data

blockingOpen: 70+% first-prediction semantic answers on genuinely unseen OpenThoughts3 not measured or achieved
V24 language engine is witnessed Q/A retrieval with hypothesis edges, not free answer discovery
native V17 whole-brain integrated live policy and original CUDA text all-GPU training not implemented
